block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master formula specification sheet for combat resolution, mitigation, and exploration checks.
what_it_enables: Physical and magical damage scaling formulas with bounded saturation
Bastion DEF and Astral MDEF mitigation and armor penetration mathematics
Accuracy vs Evasion hit probability calculation
Turn order initiative and action gauge refill rates driven by AGI / Celerity
Poise depletion and Staggered Vulnerability threshold resolution
Diegetic exploration ability check resolution (d20 + MOD vs DC)
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations during formula evaluation (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Zero-divisor protection: all divisions must use safe_div with fallback
All damage, hit chance, and progression values strictly bounded
Mitigation percentage strictly capped within [0, 90] percent (no invulnerability)

physical_damage.description: Physical strike scaling off weapon base power and Physical Attack (ATK/Might).

magical_damage.description: Magical strike scaling off spell base power, MATK (Resonance), and elemental affinity.

physical_mitigation.description: Bastion Poise (DEF) provides percentage reduction capped at 90%.

magical_mitigation.description: Astral Warding (MDEF) absorbs arcane and elemental damage up to 90% cap.

hit_resolution.description: Hit probability bounded between 5% (critical miss floor) and 95% (critical dodge ceiling).

critical_strike.description: Crits deal 150%+ damage. Flank hits add +15% crit rate; rear strikes guarantee crits.

action_gauge_refill.description: Turn order cadence and side-scroll duel recharge rate driven by Celerity (AGI).

poise_stagger.description: Depleting Poise / Flank Vigor to 0 causes Staggered state (guaranteed crits, loss of action).

exploration_check.description: Exploration checks test the 8 Exploration stats (1-20 scale) against environmental Difficulty Classes.

level_progression.description: Progressive EXP curve capping at Level 99.

tripwires.action: Ensure physical and magical mitigation never exceed 90% ceiling
